description: A VisionSearch Agent that autonomously performs tasks by processing diverse data with image recognition tools to identify objects, patterns, or text; OCR for extracting text from images or documents; and search engines/web browsers for real-time online information—supporting visual search, automated tagging, content analysis, and comprehensive research with accurate results.

tools.name: ImageRecognitionTool
tools.description: A tool that uses machine learning algorithms to analyze images and identify objects, patterns, or features within them.

tools.name: OCRTool
tools.description: Optical Character Recognition tool that extracts text from images or scanned documents, converting it into editable and searchable data.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to navigate the web, retrieve information, and interact with online resources in real-time.

tools.name: SearchEngine
tools.description: A tool that conducts searches across various databases and the internet to find relevant information based on user queries.

tools.name: DataAnalysisTool
tools.description: A tool that processes and analyzes data to derive insights, trends, and patterns, enhancing the agent's decision-making capabilities.

tools.name: AutomatedTaggingTool
tools.description: A tool that automatically assigns tags or categories to content based on its attributes, improving organization and retrieval.
